When the longest words of a table already fill the measure, each column gets
its longest word and the column of sentences gives way. Sized by its longest
cells instead, the quarters below were left 5% of the measure: XeLaTeX broke
"T2-27" at its hyphen, Typst set it into the margin.

| Persona | Rol | Nivel | Dominios | Estado | T4-26 | T1-27 | T2-27 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Alba Quintero | development | senior | metering protocols, telecontrol gateways, border routers and field firmware | Condicionado | 50 % | 100 % | 100 % |
| Bruno Lezcano | development | senior | axiom-border, lite gateways and the provisioning pipeline | Aceptado | 80 % | 50 % | 50 % |
| Celia Montoro | architecture | principal | identity, certificates, northbound integrations and the operations console | Tentativo | 20 % | 40 % | 60 % |
